{{Otheruses|Virus}}
A '''retrovirus''' was an RNA [[virus]] that was duplicated in a host cell to produce [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] from its RNA genome. [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]] invented his own retrovirus and injected it into himself to turn his [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorians]] into [[maxi-chlorian]]s.

The [[voxyn]], a creature genetically engineered by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], had its paws coated in a slime layer containing hundreds of retroviruses, making a rake with the claws fatal.
